marketing_description: The VELUX FS C06 2004S Fixed Skylight features a laminated, Low-E3 glass and a pre-finished wood frame in gray/white, providing a durable and energy-efficient solution. This deck-mount skylight has a daylight area of 4.43 sq-ft and includes a white room-darkening solar powered shade. With a U-Factor of 0.28 and 99% UV protection, this skylight offers a reliable choice for trade buyers.
